name: @agency/worker
//test: `find`, not a glob. pnpm runs scripts under sh, where `**` is `*` — so the old `src/**/*.test.ts` expanded to `src/*/*.test.ts` and any test file at another depth was silently never run, which is the worst kind of green. A quoted glob would push the expansion into the test runner, but that only works on Node 22+; on Node 20 the runner prints 'Could not find' and exits 0, which is the same silent pass again. `find` gives the same answer on both. `sort` so the order is stable between machines.
